title: A Key, Watched
summary: The leaked-key web server from A Key Left Out, now with someone watching. The quiet path - read the folder, use the key, edit the timed script - barely makes a sound. Guessing and hammering do not.
story: Marigold Media (made up) is watching web01 on 10.10.4.0/24 this time. Find the exposed key and climb to root without setting off the watcher: pointed requests are fine, but big scans, failed sign-ins and password guessing are not. You start on scout.
goal: Capture both flags the quiet way and keep the full quiet bonus.
skills: quiet recon, web folder listings, SSH keys, a writable timed script, staying quiet

hints.text: The quiet path doesn't guess anything. Scan just web01 (nmap -sV 10.10.4.30), look at its folders (webscan is a few requests - fine here), grab the exposed key, and use it. A key sign-in looks like a normal login.
Once in as webadmin, root comes from the writable script root runs on a timer (ls -l /opt/maint, cat /etc/cron.d/maint) - append a line and wait. No guessing, no hammering.
Avoid pwguess and full -p- sweeps against the watched server: that is exactly what trips the watcher and gets your address blocked.
